'''Collective autonomy''' is the freedom of a group to make and execute collective decisions.

It generalise the concept of [[autonomy]] from the individual level, at which it is more frequently applied.<ref>{{#cite:Q2658}}</ref>

== At societal level ==

According to ''[[Source:No Limits to Learning (Book)|Botkin et al.]]'', the '''collective autonomy''' of a society is characterised by freedom to:<ref>{{#cite:Q2658}}</ref>

* Maintain a distinct [[cultural identity]]
* Construct and maintain its own socioeconomical structures
* Define its own objectives of development and formulate independent strategies
